newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS affirms Teck ratings, stable outlook.
newsitem.headline: CBRS affirms Teck ratings, stable outlook.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Monday that it affirmed the debt ratings of Teck Corp and maintained the mining concern's stable rating outlook.
CBRS said it affirmed the rating of A(Low) on Teck's US$125 million of 8.7 percent debentures and B++ on its US$170 million of 6 percent convertible subordinated debentures.
The company's C$100 million commercial paper program was also affirmed at A-1/Prime Quality, the agency said.
All of the securities maintain their stable rating outlook, CBRS said.

The outlook recognizes the strength of Teck's balance sheet and continuation of healthy earnings in the near to medium term, CBRS said. The demand outlook for copper, zinc, gold and coal is expected to generate strong levels of cashflow and support the company's credit quality, the agency said.
